supersedes.status_of_v2: Never executed; no result, manifest, basis, lock, or authority artifact exists.
supersedes.reason: Pre-outcome red-team found that v2 conditioned each projected site only on P/E neighbor states. It could therefore pass for a co-adapted package even if the same newly fitted projected site were harmful with its neighbor deployed. V3 adds every deployed-neighbor conditional and retention gate and clarifies the literal PCA RNG protocol.

motivation: The authoritative exact-live MLP0--2 cube is strongly nonadditive: heldout joint gain is 0.514344 nats, joint-minus-singletons is 0.458603, and MLP2 changes from harmful alone to helpful after upstream restoration. A valid simplification interface must therefore work not only as a P0+P1 package but as individually positive projected sites across deployed, projected, and exact neighbor states, with and without exact MLP2.
scope: One fixed authoritative FineWeb ship realization. Fit rank-64 residual bases on the document-disjoint basis split, freeze them before any discovery or heldout arm, and score oracle projections on fixed discovery and heldout splits. No coefficient predictor, semantic variable, OOD, training, edit, compression, whole-model-fraction, or simplicity license is created.

fixed_design.arms: Complete 3x3x2=18 lattice. Arm keys are three letters in MLP0,MLP1,MLP2 order, using N/P/E. Rescore all arms in this execution; never splice row outcomes from prior runs.
fixed_design.basis_fit: On all 96 registered basis rows only, capture the exact original-minus-deployed residual at positions 64::3 under the restored deployed ship. Seed CPU and CUDA once at 161803 immediately before the fixed MLP0-then-MLP1 fit loop; do not reseed between sites. At each site compute uncentered rank-256 torch.pca_lowrank(niter=4) and freeze the first 64 orthonormal output directions at absolute scale 1. Persist and validate an immutable basis artifact and receipt before discovery/heldout scoring.
fixed_design.sequential_semantics: Every arm runs in model order. P and E corrections are recomputed from the live exact original-minus-deployed residual at that arm's current state. Thus MLP1 sees the state produced by selected MLP0 and MLP2 sees both upstream selections. Clear and verify correction state between arms.
fixed_design.evaluation: Score paired per-row global CE on all 192 discovery and 192 heldout FineWeb rows using positions 64--255 and the discovery-frozen rare-vocabulary mask. Restore and behaviorally verify the exact frozen ship; require component-tree identity, an epsilon-scaled exact-patch canary, exact-subcube rowwise reproduction of authoritative v4, and exact heldout baseline replay.
fixed_design.bootstrap: For discovery and heldout separately, use 2000 paired source-document-cluster draws. Sample unique documents with replacement, retain all chunks, divide by sampled row count to preserve the registered row/token-weighted estimand, and share multiplicities across all 18 arms. Seed 31415926 plus split index. Recompute every conditional, max/best-arm comparison, exact-effect check, and 0.40 margin inside each draw.
fixed_design.ratio_rule: Never gate on a bootstrap ratio. For projected effect dP and exact effect dE from the identical background, require dE>0 and dP-0.40*dE>0. Require both discovery and heldout point estimates positive and heldout document-cluster CI95 lower bound above zero. Forty percent is an advancement threshold for a partial oracle subprogram, not high-fidelity certification.
fixed_design.denominator_rule: Only paired effects within this 18-arm execution are exact references. The 0.8976-nat whole-ship gap and every cross-realization value are forbidden as MLP0--2 denominators.

no_free_rider.gate: Every one of the twelve contrasts is positive on discovery and heldout and has heldout document-cluster CI95 lower bound above zero.

same_background_retention.gate: For every background, the paired exact effect and 0.40 projected margin are positive on both splits with heldout CI95 lower bounds above zero. Nonpositive exact effects are non-identifying and fail closed.

package_and_downstream.gate: Every contrast, including both exact upstream references, is positive on discovery and heldout with heldout document-cluster CI95 lower bound above zero.

interpretation.complete_pass: Licenses the frozen rank-64 MLP0 and MLP1 residual subspaces as individually positive, non-free-riding oracle interfaces across deployed, projected, and exact neighbor states and live exact MLP2 on this realization and these FineWeb splits. The next licensed experiment is a separately fitted no-teacher-forcing coefficient program.
interpretation.package_only: If PPN/PPE pass but singleton, mixed P/E, or leave-one-site-out gates fail, treat PCA0+PCA1 only as one co-adapted joint oracle component and price it jointly; never claim modular sites.
interpretation.downstream_failure: If projected arms pass without MLP2 but fail with MLP2, the subspaces do not preserve the downstream state interface. If only live exact MLP2 rescues CE, label it adaptive compensation rather than transported state equivalence.
interpretation.oracle_only: Every P arm still evaluates the missing original MLP to obtain residual coefficients. Even complete success identifies causal output subspaces, not a replacement program. A program claim requires frozen coefficient maps, original-MLP calls poisoned during evaluation, reusable components across backgrounds, gauge-invariant physical-response tests, and explicit standalone/amortized pricing.
interpretation.failure: Report all signed point estimates and intervals. Prune any free-riding site or redefine/preregister the interface before predictor fitting; never tune rank, scale, background family, or thresholds on these outcomes.

failure_and_authority_policy: Use an isolated v3 namespace, atomic partial artifacts, and fail closed. Result and manifest payloads remain non-self-authorizing. Only a last-written atomic authority receipt may authorize scored interpretation by binding exact result, manifest, basis artifact/receipt, preregistration, frozen realization, row receipt, and committed source hashes. Preserve every failure and never overwrite v1, v2, or v4 artifacts.
